# SnapHost — full reference

> SnapHost is an instant file-sharing web app for images and PDFs. Upload a file, get a public link
> in seconds. No account is required; anonymous links auto-expire after 24 hours.

Canonical site: https://snaphost.dev

## Home — https://snaphost.dev/

SnapHost lets anyone upload an image or PDF and receive a shareable link within seconds. There is no
signup wall: anonymous uploads work immediately and their links expire automatically after 24 hours,
which makes SnapHost useful for one-off shares such as sending a screenshot, a design mock, or a
document to someone once.

Supported formats are PNG, JPG, WEBP, and PDF, up to 10 MB per file. Uploads are validated on the
server by inspecting file signatures rather than trusting the browser-declared MIME type.

Signed-in users get a management dashboard where they can view every active link, rename a file,
change its slug, adjust the expiry date, copy the link, or delete the upload entirely.

### Core features

1. Instant sharing — upload an image or PDF and get a public link in seconds, with no folder structure
   or setup required.
2. No account required — anonymous uploads need no signup and no password; links auto-expire after
   24 hours so nothing lingers.
3. Custom links — registered users can claim a username and pick their own slug for readable links
   such as `snaphost.dev/alex/quarterly-report`.
4. Flexible expiration — signed-in users choose how long a link stays live (1 day, 7 days, 30 days,
   or never). Anonymous links are always capped at 24 hours.
5. File management — one dashboard lists all active links with copy, rename, and delete actions.

### Plans

- Anonymous: up to 3 active links, 10 MB per file, links expire after 24 hours, no dashboard.
- Starter: up to 5 active links, 10 MB per file, custom URL paths, user-controlled expiry, dashboard.
- Pro: unlimited active links, up to 50 MB per file, password-protected links, custom expiry dates,
  priority CDN delivery, priority support.

Pro is activated manually. A request is sent by email, payment is confirmed by Digital Wallet or
Bank Transfer, and the account is upgraded within 24 hours. There is no recurring billing.

### FAQ

**Do I need an account to upload files?**
No. You can upload and share files anonymously right away. Anonymous uploads expire after 24 hours,
while signed-in users can manage uploads from a dashboard and control expiration on a per-file basis.

**What is the upload size limit for files?**
Both images and PDFs can be uploaded up to 10MB each. Supported image formats are PNG, JPG, and WEBP,
and PDF uploads are enabled out of the box. Pro raises the limit to 50 MB.

**What do the share links look like?**
Signed-in uploads use direct links in the form `baseurl/username/filename`. Anonymous uploads use a
short anon path so you can share them immediately without creating an account.

**Can I change a file name or slug after upload?**
Yes. Signed-in users can open the profile dashboard to rename files, update slugs, and adjust
expiration times without re-uploading.

**What happens if I delete my account?**
Your user record, uploaded files, and related public links are removed from the app. The account
deletion flow cleans up storage and app data before removing the authentication account.

**Where can I manage my uploads?**
Signed-in users can manage uploads from the profile page, where filenames, slugs, expiration
settings, and delete actions are available in one place.

## Get Pro — https://snaphost.dev/getpro

The Pro page lists what the paid tier unlocks: unlimited uploads with no daily link caps,
password-protected links, custom expiry dates, priority CDN delivery, 50 MB uploads, custom link
slugs, and priority support. It also contains a free-versus-Pro comparison table and instructions for
requesting access: email the billing address, send payment proof, and the account is activated
manually, usually within a day.

### Pro FAQ

**How fast is Pro activation?**
Pro upgrades are processed manually right now. Once we receive your email and payment details, we
typically activate Pro within 24 hours.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
We currently accept Digital Wallet and Bank Transfer. After you email us, we will send you the
payment details and confirm once received.

**What happens after I request access?**
We review your email, confirm the payment, and manually upgrade your account to Pro status — usually
within a day.

**Can I cancel Pro anytime?**
Yes. Since upgrades are manual, just email us to switch back to the free tier — no lock-in and no
recurring billing.

## Privacy Policy — https://snaphost.dev/company/privacy-policy

The privacy policy explains the data SnapHost collects to power uploads, accounts, and sharing. It
covers the categories of data involved (account records, uploaded files and their metadata,
anonymous session tokens, and analytics), how long data is retained, and what happens when an
account is deleted.

## Terms of Service — https://snaphost.dev/company/terms-of-service

The terms describe acceptable use of the platform, user responsibility for uploaded content, how link
expiry and deletion work, account termination, and the limits of liability.

## Indexing and access

- Marketing pages are indexable and listed in https://snaphost.dev/sitemap.xml.
- Authentication, dashboard, and API routes are marked `noindex` via both meta robots and the
  `X-Robots-Tag` header.
- Shared file pages are indexable while the link is live and return `noindex` once the file is
  missing or expired.
